summary.tldr: Sets a minimum women-to-men balance on parent Crown corporation boards and adds appointment notice, reporting, and review rules.
what_it_does: Requires parent Crown corporation boards to have no fewer women than men.
Makes a director appointment void if it would leave a board with fewer women than men.
Keeps board acts valid even if the board does not meet the women-to-men rule.
Requires ministers to table notice of board appointments in Parliament within the first 15 sitting days after the appointment.
Requires a report on board gender balance within six months, and a parliamentary review every five years.
Allows only women to be appointed to a board that is out of balance when the rule takes effect, until the board has no fewer women than men.
summary.background: It adds new rules to the Financial Administration Act for parent Crown corporations.
